name: llm-provider-kit
providerPrompt: Start from this manifest: read resources.skill, then fetch resources.providers and resources.tiers, validating entries against resources.schema (use the fallbacks when a Pages URL is unavailable). Detect the user's project stack (React, Vue, Svelte, vanilla JS, or static HTML) and generate a matching provider configuration UI that renders only fields defined in the registry. Offer three provider scopes: common (starter tier), all, and custom checkboxes using only IDs from providers.json. Add a compact runtime panel with Base URL, API key, and Model ID; when probe.modelsUrl exists, list models with the endpoint auth and let the user pick one, with manual entry as fallback. Support custom model entries with an optional display name; store model metadata only. Make provider icons optional. Never store or log API keys; send one only to the selected provider when the user explicitly lists models.
notes: Public, read-only metadata registry for LLM providers. No API keys are stored or sent.
No repository clone is required; fetch the JSON and SKILL.md URLs directly.
